notes.title: UNBEATABLE releases on Nov 6
notes.notes:
[p]Hi! Watch this.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Vkvi71znX_Q?feature=shared"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]As of [i]seconds[/i] ago, that premiered on stage at Geoff Keighley’s Gamescom’s Opening Night Live Twenty Twenty Five. I know at least a full third of you are immediately going back and frame-by-framing through that, but before you leave, I will kindly ask you let me reiterate: [b]UNBEATABLE releases on November 6th, 2025 for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X (and S).* [/b][/p][p][/p][p]That’s only [b]one year [/b] and [b]eleven months [/b]after the release timing we put on our kickstarter four and a half years ago! That’s only, like, what, two and a half baby’s worth? (And let me tell you: this game is not half a baby.**)[/p][p][/p][p]Let me tell you some things about this game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/ef01fa351340150f6b703632a50374fedf32eaf6.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h3][b]UNBEATABLE IS THE NAME OF A NARRATIVE GAME THAT WILL LAST 6-8 HOURS***[/b]
 [/h3][p]I am saying nothing more about it. (again, to those third of you already doing so, Enjoy Combing Through The Trailer.) [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/a84f946051258ebf96709642d3abc8408bf688ca.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]UNBEATABLE IS THE NAME OF AN ARCADE GAME THAT WILL LAST INFINITY HOURS[/b]

[/h3][p]There’s far more to it than the demo has shown off (hello, my name is Mister Obvious. i wrote this sentence); the mysterious challenge board will finally not be so mysterious, there’ll be a combination of online leaderboards, cosmetic unlocks(!?), and the “””””STAR Rating”””””” system**** which we will explain more about in the future. We’re targeting a launch with 65+ playable songs (most of which we made ourselves!) and that will only grow over time. Almost all of them will be playable at every difficulty level from the beginning. :) [/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/58e3dd0a491d21140958f41ee92e6bf72fb38f2a.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]UNBEATABLE IS AT GAMESCOM[/b][/h3][p]
[/p][p]If you are also here in Germany for Gamescom proper, you’ll be able to play the demo with two new songs rotating in - LONER(some of you just had a little ! appear over your head), and something literally called PROPER RHYTHM BPM 271 MEMODEMO SWAG BOOTLEG. It’s by MEMODEMO, and it sounds exactly like what’s in your head when you read that just now.[/p][p]
Okay we lied you can expect this same update to hit the PC/PS5 demo today too, you do not need to be at the event. But the booth is very cool and it has this in it:  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/f66fb7839fc10048554d3dca33602a9f7ed89a05.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]It also will sometimes have some of the team in it! RJ, Andrew (the directors), Rachel, and Jeff (the producers) are all there in person. The booth will also have free goodies (hooray!). For most of us, it’s our first time in The Europe, and that’s Spooky. [/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]UNBEATABLE IS GETTING LOCALIZED…[/b][/h3][p]
[/p][p]…to Simplified Chinese at launch. We still plan on adding other languages but they will be following [i]after[/i]. This is to ensure we have as much time as possible to have the chance to QA the new language, which is a thing you need to do because the [i]last[/i] thing you should do when translating a game is just throw it in and cross your fingers. This should make it possible for the two to be in a quality that meets our standards. We hear a lot of you that you want UNBEATABLE in your language - but with a script this big, it’ll always be a tough effort to localize this game.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]UNBEATABLE IS WOW THIS IS REALLY HAPPENING HUH?[/b][/h3][h3]
[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/9bc63f09447e4afbaf904815f1e35d07ae8ce4d4.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]We’ll share more soon. That’s all for now.*****[/p][p]Thanks for being you.

[/p][p]<3 FROM D-CELL


*assuming nothing goes wrong [/p][p]**it’s at least one and a half [/p][p]***way longer if you take your time or way shorter if you decide to quit the game early[/p][p]****name [b]subject to change******[/b][/p][p]*****btw for our crowdfunding backers we’ll update our plans on final fulfillment soon (SORRY IT’S TAKING SO LONG but there are some exciting things to announce there…) ******but probably it won’t[/p]

notes.title: Participate in UNBEATABLE: ARCADE FINALS II, a new competitive score contest!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/eb667beb5713099b406afaa4b8ad29eceab5f81d.png"][/img][/p][p]Are you ready to show what you've got? We recommend everyone to participate, as we'll award a cool swag Discord role for those participating (like we've done in the past!). notes.title: SOUNDTRACK PRE-ORDERS LIVE (and more!)
notes.notes: [p]You can pre-order the full soundtracks for UNBEATABLE beginning RIGHT NOW. [/p][p][/p][p]Check our bandcamp where you’ll be able to pre-order both [url="https://dcellgames.bandcamp.com/album/album"]ALBUM (by UNBEATABLE)[/url], and [url="https://dcellgames.bandcamp.com/album/unbeatable-ost"]UNBEATABLE \[ost][/url]. The former contains all of the vocal songs (WAITING! FAMILIAR! The songs from the trailers!), while the latter will contain the full score; all BGM, cop fight, and minigame tracks. If you already backed a tier in our Kickstarter / Slacker Backer campaign with the game’s soundtrack included, you will receive both releases, in full, on Day 1 - no additional purchase needed.[/p][p][/p][p]To coincide with this announcement, we’ve got three major announcements as well:  [/p][p][/p][h1]LISTEN TO OUR PERFORMANCE OF WORN OUT TAPES AT DAY OF THE DEVS [/h1][p]A labor of love between the sound team, listen to our performance of a brand new rendition of WORN OUT TAPES, which debuted at DAY OF THE DEVS: SUMMER GAME FEST 2025!  [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="S-44j6302BY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This new song is included as a part of our [url="https://dcellgames.bandcamp.com/album/album"]pre-order launch for the vocal album[/url], and will also be available for listening on YouTube. If you’ve listened to UNBEATABLE: DEMO TAPES, you may be familiar with WORN OUT TAPES, but that version is a lot closer to the B-Sides we are doing for the final release. In truth, we had always planned on making a new version of WORN OUT TAPES that better reflected the game’s aesthetic changes, as the now named “\[tally-ho! version]” was developed all the way back in late 2018, before we had fully identified the direction we were taking with the game. With how much that’s changed since, we see WORN OUT TAPES as a full circle moment - one that really unites the early days of this project with what the game is today! Attached at the end of this post is the full MV credits.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/ce1984ea85994afcbcda7073095de34963054326.png"][/img][/p][p]You can download this new version of Worn Out Tapes as a pre-order bonus for UNBEATABLE: THE ALBUM. Soundtrack Backers will receive a download as a part of redeeming their pre-order key for the soundtrack. We’ll be sending these out starting the moment this post goes live - give it at least up to 24 hours for the keys to arrive. In the event they don’t make it to your inbox, reach out to dev@dcellgames.com with your backer details and we’ll get it fixed ASAP.[/p][p][/p][h1]PLAY WORN OUT TAPES, from THE ALBUM, in the UNBEATABLE \[DEMO] BEGINNING JUNE 9TH  [/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/eb667beb5713099b406afaa4b8ad29eceab5f81d.png"][/img][/p][p]This new version of WORN OUT TAPES, as well as the original WORN OUT TAPES ( the “\[tally-ho! version]”), will be our new rotational songs for the DEMO, replacing both FUTURE PEOPLE and SLEEPING IN. You’ll have this weekend to get your final scores in for those two songs, before WORN OUT TAPES swaps in during Steam Next Fest!  [/p][p]These new charts were created by game producer CHI XU with the assistance of Cheryl Stelli.  [/p][p]Since this build has already been in the oven for a while, we have the patch notes for the version releasing, [b]PATCH V1.6.1-DOTD [/b]- take a look at the changes we’re making on Monday! [/p][p][/p][h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2][list][*][p]Sleeping In and Future People are replaced with WORN OUT TAPES and WORN OUT TAPES \[tally-ho! Version] in UNBEATABLE \[arcade mode] [/p][/*][*][p]You are now sent back to the \[arcade mode] menu rather than the main menu upon quitting a song in UNBEATABLE \[arcade mode] [/p][/*][*][p]A fix was made to the skybox shader in the rhythm game scenes - the sky is no longer gray in them! [/p][/*][*][p]You can now skip pre-rendered videos (which should allow people who are softlocked by this on certain devices to progress). [/p][/*][*][p]Subtitle Rendering was fixed.  [/p][/*][/list][h1]THE FULL DEMO OST IS OUT ON YOUTUBE (and included with a pre-order of UNBEATABLE: THE SOUNDTRACK)  [/h1][p]We’ve heard you! The full demo OST is now available to listen on YT, featuring all of the background music, minigame tracks, and miscellaneous extras not included in UNBEATABLE: DEMO TAPES, peak divide’s single releases, or the upcoming UNBEATABLE: THE ALBUM release. Note that the YouTube uploads for these tracks may not be final renditions of the songs, and are subject to change prior to release.  [/p][p]Listen to the whole soundtrack, with all rhythm songs and BGM together, on our YouTube channel [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lJc-PytqtQY&list=PLdkSCrAWCqGbJZDOmvBEnlnMY06ZVmWVo&ab_channel=D-CELL"]here[/url].[/p][p]We’re making this a summer to remember, so be sure to stick around - we’ll have a lot more to share throughout the season about the game. Thank you for your support and sticking with us - it’s meant the world.  [/p][p][/p][p][b][i][u]<3 FROM D-CELL[/u][/i][/b]  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]FULL MV CREDITS: VIDEO PRODUCTION by RJ Lake, COMPOSITION AND ARRANGEMENT by Clara Maddux, and Vasily Nikolaev, LYRICS by Clara Maddux and Rachel Lake, PERFORMANCES by Clara Maddux (Guitar / Drums), Rachel Lake (Vocals), and Vasily Nikolaev (Synth). FILMING by RJ Lake, Vasily Nikolaev, Jeffrey Chiao, and Moxie Riles. Featuring LEVEL DESIGN by Jeffrey Chiao and Cheryl Stelli, and ANIMATION/VISUALS by Andrew Tsai, Eli Stavridis, Andi Bao Nguyen, Denise D. Bacic, Yumna Taqiyyah, and Starapture.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p]*Artwork for both albums are not final.[/p]

notes.title: [DEMO] PATCH V1.5.27 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/00cf738e82b7c35fbc1a0750fa5e24d2b58ae0d8.png[/img]
Hey gang,

We return with some quick changes to round out yesterday's beefy patch for the demo! Take a look below:

[h1]PATCH V1.5.27 CHANGELOG[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed the softlock that can occur if the player manages to attempt finishing a poster twice in one run.
[*]UNBEATABLE [arcade mode] now remembers the last song you selected after completing it, meaning you won't be reset back to Empty Diary after each play!
[*]Fixed various UX bugs relating to UNBEATABLE [arcade mode].
[/list]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]
[list]
[*] some Arcade Mode settings, notably keybinds, do not save in the options menu for Arcade Mode (save them in the main menu in the meantime!)
[*] we're aware of some other arcade mode QoL/bugs that we're going to address in future patches!
[/list]

As mentioned before, future patches lined up for the demo will include more QOL fixes for UNBEATABLE [arcade mode] and later on, additional playable languages! For PS5 players, we're working on updates to have parity with the PC version of the demo - they're still in progress (cert is complicated), so thank you for your patience!


That's all from us!
[b][i]<3 FROM D-CELL[/i][/b]

notes.title: [DEMO] PATCH V1.5.26.7 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/00cf738e82b7c35fbc1a0750fa5e24d2b58ae0d8.png[/img]

Hey gang,

We're excited to announce that over 30k players (50k downloads) have played the UNBEATABLE [DEMO] on Steam! Thank you so much to everyone for checking out this first look at the game - means the world seeing all the fan art, feedback, and arcade scores since then.

We have a bunch of fixes lined up for this patch, which should hopefully fix a lot of present issues we've detected throughout the past few days. Take a look and let us know what you think!
[h1]
[b]PATCH V1.5.26.7 Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] fixed navmesh issues that cause Beat to get stuck in the waterfront
[*] fixed an issue that caused the results screen to display incorrectly after playing a brawl
[*] fixed an issue that could cause a softlock if you spammed the interact key while ending an environmental interactable
[*] fixed an issue that allowed [spoiler]the whacktown nightmare[/spoiler] to be accessible even when whacktown's hard difficulty wasn't completed
[*] fixed an issue that could cause a softlock when trashing posters in the poster craft minigame
[*] potentially fixed an issue that could cause placing posters to freeze on the final camera transition
[*] fixed tutorial softlocks (if any remain, please let us know)
[*] fixed several softlocks related to the game accepting dialogue inputs while the pause menu is active
[*] fixed a softlock inside of the whacktown minigame when loading into it right before the time of day transition occurs
[*] fixed softlock that occurs when quitting inside of dialogue that is "waiting" on an event to complete
[*] fixed an issue that would cause poster quest dialogue to not run if the player quits in the middle of it
[*] dramatically improved performance of the waterfront on low-end hardware
[*] dramatically improved video playback performance on low powered hardware
[*] fixed the pause menu clipping through the desk in [spoiler]Rest's office[/spoiler]
[*] fixed clipping when zooming into the journal
[*] fixed audio persisting after returning to the main menu
[*] fixed certain timed dialogue triggers not working!
[*] fixed incorrect collision in multiple scenes!
[*] fixed dream lipsync dialogue bubble placement
[*] added a scroll speed slider to the story difficulty menu
[*] increased the size of the "go to bed" trigger, and made the task more obvious
[*] altered in game control displays for the default control scheme (they now display LB and RB rather than LB and A - the controls themselves have not changed, however.)
[*] fixed a softlock that could occur in the shack intro if you quit and return while cleaning up
[*] fixed an issue where the story difficulty settings would be incorrect after resetting your story progress
[*] added some more stickers to the poster craft minigame :)
[/list]

KNOWN ISSUES:
[list]
[*] a softlock can occur if the player manages to attempt finishing a poster twice in one run (by resetting story progress and starting again). restarting the game should resolve this issue!
[*] some Arcade Mode settings, notably keybinds, do not save in the options menu for Arcade Mode (save them in the main menu in the meantime!)
[*] we're aware of some other arcade mode QoL/bugs that we're going to address in a future patch!
[/list]

Future patches lined up for the demo will include QOL fixes for UNBEATABLE [arcade mode] and later on, additional playable languages! For PS5 players, we're working on updates to have parity with the PC version of the demo - they're still in progress (cert is complicated), so thank you for your patience!

[i][b]<3 FROM D-CELL[/b][/i]

notes.title: New Song Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey gang, 

We told you the marketing machine was getting started. We're back with another reveal - the full release of a new song for the game, one that some of you have been wanting to hear since we teased it a long time back!

Here's [i]Sleeping In[/i], written by game director RJ Lake, arranged by Clara and Vasily @ peak divide, and vocals by Rachel Lake! It's available now on [url=https://peakdivide.bandcamp.com/album/sleeping-in]Bandcamp[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6yA6GlA1xxw]YouTube[/url] as a single release. Go go go!

[previewyoutube=6yA6GlA1xxw;full][/previewyoutube]

You'll be able to play this song and more in the upcoming demo that we've yet to spill the deets on yet - don't worry, that's something we'll be more than happy to share more about soon, promise! And we really mean it. Seriously.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/17dc4496701e60a26b544d28b45296e976be4ba5.jpg[/img]
(artwork by Game Director Andrew Tsai)

Say, on the other side of things, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2093940/vividstasis/]vivid/stasis[/url] is getting another [url=https://peakdivide.bandcamp.com/album/unbeatable-demo-tapes]DEMO TAPES[/url] classic from us on March 22nd, I wonder what the heck that's all about?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/497eddf10535902a1662653e20c94c1c31b39d9c.jpg[/img]

That'll be all from us for now. Thank you so much to everyone who checked our booth out at MAGFest. The fire marshal had a field day with us! You'll be hearing from us soon, but if you want to keep in touch outside of here, we've got [url=http://twitter.com/dcellgames]Twitter[/url], [url=http://discord.gg/dcellgames]Discord[/url], and [url=https://bsky.app/profile/dcellgames.com]Bluesky[/url], the last of which is presently a very good demonstration of what happens when RJ has total reins over a video game company social media account.

Till next time!

notes.title: UNBEATABLE 2025 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
WELCOME TO THE NEW YEAR

We just returned from our extremely mandatory company break and are back to making anime real! Happy 2025! That number is ringing a bell. Why is th-

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/3c930a5306d3848b05b568a5ebe50f4a37fcf2a3.png[/img]

oh

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/4f9ae9b1d5bfd05d5ca8a65f1332162bb86ef94d.png[/img]

oh no

...uh, guys, how much of the game is left to make?

[h3][b]HOW MUCH OF THE GAME IS LEFT TO MAKE[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/21f9d9522c949048042143de5aa84599a9bab866.png[/img]

BEFORE WE ACTUALLY ANSWER THAT we need to be thanking you all yet again. The game has had a crazy reception both by our longtime fans [strike](that's you guys here on Kickstarter and also those who have been with us even longer)[/strike] and some new ones [strike](I'd say hi to you but you aren't probably reading this. You're reading the version of this post we're putting elsewhere, and that version of this post doesn't have this parenthetical. Unless someone messed something up).[/strike] The steam page has cleared 150k wishlists and it keeps moving like a train and we're so grateful we're going to explode.

After our big re-announcement (and also before that re-announcement) we've been slamming out several of the game’s chapters simultaneously. To answer that question, though...quite a bit is left! That's how it goes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/27bf95d4c601c1d18c5dfaf702bdacd8a34a62b9.png[/img]

BUT DO NOT WORRY. We’ve gotten a [b]lot[/b] of work done on getting this closer to being an actual honest to god video game that we can put on your television. Your wait has been Far Too Long, and things always feel like they move Far Too Slow (if 1: you want it faster and 2: you or someone you know wins the lottery then 3: talk to us) but games are work and this is work and we want this thing to work and that takes...effort 

So what have we been efforting on? Well, there’s a lot shown in the trailer (and past material) that you haven’t seen yet and for today…it’ll continue to be that way!~

[h3][b]Sorry[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/3d83affc4324f57587e7a7857be5b7b756fa0714.png[/img]

ok fine i'll post this, this is new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/c3297db8b778832c6bdda1be09e9f3c9065f57d7.png[/img]

But we can't give away a lot more right now partially because we are going to need to save things to show soon. Thankfully soon means soon.

The marketing machine has begun. As these months go on you’ll be seeing more throughout the year as we approach release, with lots of fun news and reveals planned for our pre-launch period. We already tended to be shy about spamming updates on Kickstarter (or our blog) if they’re not major, because we believe in the Power Of The Reveal. On top of that, Playstack needs us to Be On Socials. So we are (notably check out the D-CELL [url=https://bsky.app/profile/dcellgames.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://x.com/dcellgames]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@dcellgames]TikTok[/url]) and that's where any smaller tidbits from us will live! Also say hi please

Oh, actually, speaking of the marketing machine, there is one big thing left to talk about right now:

[h2][b]UNBEATABLE @ MAGFest 2025!!!!!!![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/750e5aaf420ea6cc830b5f8af059c3f326db6e00.png[/img]

(pretend that text is shaking and way bigger and, like, airhorns are blaring)


As you may have seen on social media a while back, we’ll be returning to MAGFest FOR THE SEVENTH TIME in January with several surprises. If you want them to still be surprises, stop reading

This is the last time we're doing this before the game’s full release*! You’ll see a bunch of the team there, get a chance to play a build of UNBEATABLE with early previews of upcoming songs, and more! Let’s break down what you can expect:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/2b4610a9e673ba24c32b15e306e9379ea6c99283.png[/img]

And an event-exclusive shirt by Eli! Same high-quality screenprint and t-shirt manufacture as we always do. I will be wearing this. (it's available from XS-XL)

notes.title: New Song Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey Gang, 

First of all we just wanted to say THANK YOU for all the love and support since our reveal trailer over the Summer. The passion you've all shown for the game has blown us away and has only made us more excited to get this game into your hands in 2025!!

So as a little gift from us, and a fun way to celebrate Steam Rhythm Festival, we thought we'd drop a brand new song from the UNBEATABLE soundtrack - "Future People"

[previewyoutube=jxnqBZHDhUY;full][/previewyoutube]

You can read a whole lot more about "Future People" in our brand new post on the PlayStation Blog where we also go into details on the song making process as well as highlighting some features coming to the PlayStation version of the game! 

[url=https://blog.playstation.com/2024/08/19/unbeatable-new-song-and-immersive-ps5-gameplay-detailed-for-the-rhythm-based-anime-adventure/][h1]🔵 [u]PLAYSTATION BLOG POST[/u][/h1][/url]

You can even see a sneak peak at the beat map for Future People...speaking of which, we are happy to confirm that you will be able to play this song for yourself in our upcoming demo! 

We are working super hard to make sure the demo is the best it can possibly be so you'll have to hang on a bit longer for some news, but rest assured it will be worth the wait.

Aaaaaanyway that will do for now. Please enjoy Steam Rhythm Fest and some of the amazing games from our friends, there are so many cool demos to check out!!

<3 FROM D-CELL GAMES
